verdict.rationale: Fastmail's Snooze feature lets messages resurface in the Inbox at a chosen future time, covering the 'snooze conversations' half of the story, but there is no evidence of a conditional follow-up reminder that resurfaces a thread specifically 'if nobody replies' (a reply-tracking nudge feature). Missing for 10: no-reply detection/follow-up reminder logic, evidence of thread-level (vs single-message) snoozing, and independent/hands-on confirmation of snooze behavior in practice.
